clauses.title: Hygienic Practice Requirements
clauses.content: The water shall be processed, handled, packaged, and stored under strict hygienic conditions conforming to Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP).

clauses.title: Microbiological Requirements
clauses.content: Total coliforms, faecal streptococci, Salmonella, and Pseudomonas aeruginosa must be completely absent in 250 ml packaged samples.

qco.title: Drinking Water (Packaged) (Quality Control) Order, 2021
qco.product: Packaged natural mineral water and packaged drinking water
qco.scope: Mandatory BIS certification for packaged natural mineral water and packaged drinking water manufactured or sold in India, enforced jointly with FSSAI.
requirements: Valid BIS Licence under IS 14543 before packaging and sale.
Compliance with composition, contaminant, and hygiene limits specified in IS 14543.
Batch-wise testing records maintained at the manufacturing unit.
